business_scope.primary_industry_name: Automated Algorithm Underwriting for Micro Consumer Loans

stage_1.document_name: Mainland investor's business license (營業執照) notarized copy
stage_1.issuing_entity: State Administration for Market Regulation (國家市場監督管理總局) / local Administration for Market Regulation
stage_1.authentication_path: Cross-Strait notarization and SEF verification (Hague Apostille not recognized by Taiwan; China is a Hague member but Taiwan is not)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Taiwan Company Act (公司法), Articles 1, 2, 98, 108, 128-129 (limited company formation and governance); Foreign Investment Act (外国投资条例), Articles 7 and 10 (foreign investment approval); Banking Act Article 195-1 and FSC Guidelines for the Assistance of P2P Lending Platform Operators (P2P借贷平台业者辅导要点) for the FinTech special registration; Taiwan Strait Relations Act (两岸人民关系条例) Article 73 and the Regulations Governing the Permission of Investment in Taiwan by Mainland Area People (大陆地区人民来台投资许可办法) for mainland-investor screening (financial-sector negative list applies).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) Department of Commerce (经济部商业司); foreign investment screening by the MOEA Investment Commission (经济部投资审议委员会); special-regime supervision by the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) Banking Bureau (金融监督管理委员会银行局).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company (Limited Company) Establishment Registration Application (有限公司设立登记申请书) submitted electronically through the MOEA One-Stop Commercial Registration Portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The general statutory minimum paid-in capital was abolished by the 2018 Company Act Amendment; however, FSC guidance for P2P lending platforms mandates paid-up capital of NT$10,000,000 (approximately USD 330,000), which must be remitted by the foreign parent and impounded in a dedicated escrow/trust account (暂收投资款项专户) at a licensed Taiwan bank until the FSC registration certificate is issued; the escrow is released only upon registration completion.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the sole shareholder of CN_WFOE_LTD, acting as the first board of the company, hereby adopts the following resolutions: (1) The subscription of paid-up capital of NT$10,000,000 is approved, and the capital has been deposited in an escrow account at a licensed Taiwan bank pending FSC registration. (2) The registered office at No. 88, Section 1, Xinyi Road, Taipei City, is formally adopted as the company's statutory address. (3) The appointment of the Director and Statutory Representative, together with the General Manager as Chief Compliance Officer, is ratified. All officers are authorized to execute FSC filings, bank instructions, and administrative documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Approval by the MOEA Investment Commission
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) Investment Commission (经济部投资审议委员会)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Application for Investment by Foreign Nationals through the Investment Commission's online one-stop portal, annexing the corporate existence certificate of the overseas parent, audited financial statements, a detailed investment plan for the P2P micro-lending platform, and a power of attorney. The Commission performs the negative-list industry clearance (including mainland-investor restrictions under Article 73 of the Taiwan Strait Relations Act) and issues the Investment Approval Letter (投资核准函) within the statutory 90-day window; the investor must thereafter file the company registration within six months of approval.
required_dossiers: Application for Investment by Foreign Nationals (Form I)
Certificate of incorporation and corporate extract of the foreign parent (notarized and apostilled)
Audited financial statements of the foreign parent for the last fiscal year
Investment plan covering the P2P lending platform, AML/CFT framework, and algorithm underwriting model
Power of Attorney appointing the Taiwan local representative
Mainland-investor supplementary form and source-of-funds declaration (if the ultimate parent is mainland-based)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, respond to the Commission's deficiency letter within 30 days, with one optional 30-day extension. If denied on mainland-investor negative-list grounds (financial services currently restricted), the applicant may restructure through a non-mainland intermediate holding entity, seek a case-by-case exemption under Article 73 of the Taiwan Strait Relations Act, or file an administrative appeal with the Executive Yuan within 30 days; no capital may be remitted until approval is obtained.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name and Business Scope Pre-Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Department of Commerce, One-Stop Commercial Registration Platform (经济部商业司商工登记单一窗口)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Company Name and Business Scope Pre-Approval Application (公司名称及所营事业预查) using the proposed English and Chinese company names. The system verifies non-duplication with registered entities and reconciles the proposed business scope against the FSC-regulated P2P lending activity codes and the foreign-investment negative list. The name reservation is valid for six months and may be renewed once for an additional six months.
required_dossiers: Company Name Pre-Approval Application
Proposed Articles of Incorporation with business scope mapped to P2P lending activities
Shareholder identification documents and proposed capital schedule
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity, file a revised name within five working days under the same reference number. If the business scope codes are rejected, narrow the description and re-submit or request a formal interpretive opinion from the Department of Commerce.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Escrow Capital Account and Funds Remittance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Taiwan bank branch designated for foreign-investment escrow accounts (e.g., Bank SinoPac, Cathay United Bank)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a capital escrow account (暂收投资款项专户) in the proposed company name at a Banking Act-licensed branch, remit NT$10,000,000 from the foreign parent via telegraphic transfer, and obtain the deposit certificate and bank statement evidencing the paid-up capital balance. The bank must report the inward remittance to the Central Bank's Foreign Exchange Department (中央银行外汇局) within five working days.
required_dossiers: MOEA Investment Approval Letter (Step 1 output)
Company name pre-approval notice (Step 2 output)
Draft Articles of Incorporation and sole-shareholder written resolution
Source-of-funds declaration, SWIFT remittance instruction, and bank reference letter of the foreign parent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the remittance is blocked under the Foreign Exchange Control Act (管理外汇条例), submit the source-of-funds certificate and the Investment Approval Letter to the Central Bank Foreign Exchange Bureau for unfreezing; re-remittance through a correspondent bank within 30 days preserves the escrow timeline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: CPA Capital Verification and Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: FSC-registered certified public accountant (会计师事务所)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The CPA reviews the escrow bank statement, remittance vouchers, and draft Articles of Incorporation, and issues the Capital Verification Report (资本额查核报告书) certifying that the NT$10,000,000 paid-up capital is fully subscribed and actually paid. Concurrently, the sole shareholder executes the final Articles of Incorporation and the Director's consent letter, with all document dates aligned to the escrow certificate.
required_dossiers: Escrow deposit certificate and bank statement
Foreign-exchange remittance receipt (SWIFT MT103)
Draft Articles of Incorporation and shareholder minutes
CPA engagement letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the CPA reports a discrepancy between subscribed and paid-in capital, replenish the escrow account within five working days or re-file a corrected capital schedule; a substitute CPA may be engaged without restarting the registration process.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Incorporation Registration with the MOEA Department of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Department of Commerce (经济部商业司) / Taipei City Government Commercial Registration Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the electronic Establishment Registration Application (有限公司设立登记申请书) through the commercial registration portal, attaching the executed Articles of Incorporation, the Capital Verification Report, and all statutory annexes. Pay the registration fee of NT$1,000 plus the documentary stamp tax and capital-based registration fee of 0.1% of paid-in capital (NT$10,000). The authority issues the Company Registration Certificate (公司登记证明书) and the unified business number (统一编号).
required_dossiers: Establishment Registration Application Form
Executed Articles of Incorporation
CPA Capital Verification Report
Director/Statutory Representative consent letter and identity documents
Registered office lease agreement and building owner's consent
Fee payment record
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: On receipt of a deficiency notice, cure and re-submit within 15 days online. If the registrar rejects on substantive legal grounds, amend the Articles by shareholder resolution and re-file; a further administrative appeal to the MOEA must be filed within 30 days of the rejection notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and Uniform Invoice Issuance Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Bureau (台北国税局) and the Taipei City Revenue Service (税捐稽征处)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the tax registration (税籍登记) within 15 days of incorporation, obtain the taxpayer certificate for the statutory representative, and apply for the Uniform Invoice Purchase Certificate (统一发票购票证). Register the withholding tax obligations, the VAT classification applicable to fintech service fees, and the corporate income tax filing cycle; open the VAT payment account at the designated bank.
required_dossiers: Company Registration Certificate (Step 5 output)
Tax Registration Application Form 16A
Lease contract and Articles of Incorporation
Identity documents of the statutory representative
Uniform Invoice Purchase Certificate Application
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax authority assigns a VAT category requiring special invoicing for financial services, submit a written explanation together with the FSC registration evidence to amend the invoice type; late-registration penalties may be mitigated through voluntary pre-registration disclosure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: FSC Special Registration for P2P Lending Platform Operations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC), Banking Bureau (金融监督管理委员会银行局)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the P2P platform registration application under the FSC Guidelines for the Assistance of P2P Lending Platform Operators, evidencing the NT$10,000,000 paid-up capital, the bank-partnership trust/escrow agreement for customer funds, AML/CFT internal controls, audit records of the automated underwriting algorithm, and the system security assessment report. The FSC performs a fit-and-proper review of the Director and the General Manager/Chief Compliance Officer and issues the Registration Certificate (P2P网络借贷平台业务登记函) with operating covenants.
required_dossiers: Company Registration Certificate and Articles of Incorporation
FSC P2P Platform Registration Application Form
Bank cooperation and trust/escrow agreement for customer funds
AML/CFT policies, underwriting risk framework, and counterparty due diligence manual
System security assessment report and business continuity plan
Fit-and-proper declarations for the Director and General Manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the FSC returns queries, respond within 14 days with supplementary documentation. If registration is denied, the applicant may apply for an experimental authorization under the Financial Technology Development and Innovative Experimentation Act (金融科技发展与创新实验条例) within 30 days or pursue administrative review; until approval, the company may only conduct offline testing and may not accept client funds.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) Banking Bureau (金融监督管理委员会银行局), with cross-agency coordination by the Central Bank Foreign Exchange Department (中央银行外汇局) for payment rails, the Ministry of Digital Affairs (数位发展部) for cyber-security, and the Taipei City Fire Department and Public Works authorities for physical premises.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: P2P Network Lending Platform Business Registration Certificate (P2P网络借贷平台业务登记函) together with the FSC operating covenant letter governing platform conduct and customer fund protection.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment (环境部) and the Taipei City Environmental Protection Bureau (台北市环境保护局)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C (Registration class): office-based fintech operations are exempt from a full statutory EIA report; the company must file an EIA self-registration statement under Article 5(2) of the Environmental Impact Assessment Act and obtain a screening notification letter from the Taipei Environmental Protection Bureau before commencing office operations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater; sanitary effluent must comply with the Water Pollution Control Act effluent standards (COD ≤ 100 mg/L, SS ≤ 30 mg/L, pH 6-9). No VOC-emitting manufacturing processes; office printing and HVAC equipment must remain below the stationary-source TVOC threshold of 0.6 kg/hr under the Air Pollution Control Act. All solid and electronic waste must be transferred through licensed vendors under the Waste Management Act with monthly waste manifests; the company should maintain an ISO 14001-style environmental management system as a best-practice condition of the FSC covenant.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety equipment inspection certificate (消防安全设备检修证明书) must be filed with the Taipei Fire Department before commencement and renewed annually; building public-safety inspection report (建筑物公共安全检查申报书) under Article 77 of the Building Act must be obtained for the B-2 office occupancy class; occupational safety self-inspection, emergency evacuation drill records, and a server-room electrical load and structural floor-load certification by a registered structural engineer are required under the Occupational Safety and Health Act Article 6, with all records retained for at least three years.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China (国家税务总局), official e-filing portal www.chinatax.gov.cn (electronic tax bureau: etax.chinatax.gov.cn). Taiwan-region taxable activities are administered separately by the National Taxation Administration, Ministry of Finance, Taiwan (財政部賦稅署, www.mof.gov.tw), which levies profit-seeking enterprise income tax (20%) and business tax (5%); cross-strait double taxation relief is governed by the 2015 Cross-Strait Agreement on Avoidance of Double Taxation and Enhancing Tax Cooperation (海峡两岸避免双重课税及加强税务合作协议).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: The WFOE obtains its Unified Social Credit Code (统一社会信用代码, 18 digits) upon incorporation with the State Administration for Market Regulation; this UCC functions as the de facto TIN and VAT ID. Step 2: the STA performs automatic taxpayer registration and issues the electronic tax registration record (电子税务局税务登记). Step 3: the WFOE designates a legal representative and a tax filing agent (办税人员), completes the taxpayer classification election (general taxpayer versus small-scale taxpayer), and signs the three-party bank-tax direct-debit agreement (三方协议). Step 4: the WFOE activates the tax digital certificate (税务UKey) and enrols in the fully digital e-invoice platform (数电票). Foreign shareholders need no separate PRC tax ID for the entity; non-resident withholding tax profiles are set up at the time dividends, interest or royalties are paid offshore.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — the WFOE is a PRC resident enterprise subject to 25% Corporate Income Tax on worldwide income; no pass-through election exists; profits of any Taiwan-region branch are taxable within the PRC worldwide base, with foreign tax credit relief only under the Cross-Strait agreement.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Available elections: (1) VAT status — small-scale taxpayer (annual turnover up to RMB 5,000,000; simplified levy of 1%–3% with no input VAT credit) versus general taxpayer (mandatory above RMB 5,000,000 or voluntary; 6% output VAT on financial and technology services with input VAT credits); (2) export tax refund method — production-enterprise exemption-crediting-refund (免抵退) versus trading-enterprise exemption-refund (免退税); (3) CIT preferential-rate claims — High/New-Technology Enterprise (15%) or Small Low-Profit Enterprise (effective 5% on taxable income up to RMB 3,000,000); (4) thin-capitalisation ratio election for related-party debt (2:1 general, 5:1 financial enterprises); (5) no hybrid-mismatch check-the-box regime — PRC CFC and GAAR rules recharacterise hybrid funding arrangements; Taiwan-region hybrid instruments are reviewed under STA anti-avoidance rulings.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (VAT — 增值税), the PRC national GST; Taiwan-region branches additionally file business tax (營業稅) under the separate Taiwan regime.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: China: VAT exemption for small-scale taxpayers at monthly taxable sales ≤ RMB 100,000 (annual ≈ RMB 1,200,000); compulsory general-taxpayer VAT registration when annual taxable sales exceed RMB 5,000,000; however, a licensed P2P micro-lending WFOE must register for VAT from day one because it issues taxable invoices and supplies financial services (loan services and direct-charge financial services) at 6%; financial institutions receive no turnover exemption. Taiwan-region branches: business tax registration is compulsory upon licensing with no monetary threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Golden Tax Phase IV (金税四期) requires real-time data collection across invoicing, bank settlement, customs and corporate filings. New WFOEs must use the fully digitalised electronic invoice (数电票) platform of the STA; each invoice contains a 20-digit digital invoice number, an anti-counterfeit QR code (防伪码) and an XML/OFD data file transmitted to the national e-invoice service platform through government API. High-volume fintech lenders are obligated to integrate the electronic tax bureau API (电子税务局接口) for automated issuance, real-time fiscal clearance and loan-to-invoice reconciliation; any offline reconciliation gap triggers automatic VAT risk-control alerts and blocked invoice quotas.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating (零税率) with refund of input VAT applies only to exported goods and to the closed list of cross-border services (such as research and development, software design, industrial design, copyright transfer and offshore service outsourcing) that are performed and consumed entirely outside China and paid in foreign currency. Pure financial services, including loan interest and P2P platform transaction fees, are not zero-ratable; at most they qualify for cross-border VAT exemption (跨境应税行为免征增值税) where the borrowing client is a non-resident and the lending arrangement is wholly supplied and consumed offshore, with no PRC situs of collateral, guarantee or performance. The WFOE must evidence the offshore consumption, the contractual performance place, the invoice issued to the non-resident, and collection in convertible currency. Goods-export zero-rating would apply only to a separately operating export goods line, never to lending cash flows.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (出口货物报关单, with customs release stamp)
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / ocean or air transport document (提单/运单)
Inward Remittance Certificate (涉外收入申报单 / 银行收汇水单) issued by the receiving bank
Commercial invoice and packing list matching the customs declaration
Foreign trade contract / sales confirmation showing offshore buyer and settlement terms
Electronic export-rebate declaration filing (出口退税申报表) and, where applicable, the VAT special invoice or exemption notification
Proof of currency repatriation into the WFOE's designated export settlement account
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: STA and Customs jointly screen export-rebate claims through the Golden Tax risk engine; red flags include transactions with offshore related parties, unmatched customs declarations, and missing FX receipts. Consequences: (1) retrospective clawback of the refunded VAT with statutory interest and late-fee surcharges (0.05% per day); (2) administrative penalty of 50%–500% of the misdeclared tax under Tax Administration Law Art. 63; (3) criminal liability under Criminal Law Art. 204 for fraudulently obtaining export tax refunds — fine of 100%–500% of the defrauded amount and imprisonment from up to 5 years to life for amounts that are large or especially large; (4) SAFE enforcement for failure to repatriate export proceeds — warnings, fines of up to RMB 300,000, suspension of foreign-exchange receipt qualification, and downgrade of the WFOE's trade-inspection integrity rating; (5) unlimited clawback period for fraudulent rebate claims; legal representatives, tax filing agents and beneficial owners bear joint and several liability.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC) and State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), with the Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan) (CBC) regulating the TWD settlement side and cross-strait RMB clearing arrangements through the Bank of China Taipei Branch.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China maintains IMF Article VIII current-account convertibility, but the capital account is subject to SAFE registration and quota controls. Renminbi in the cross-border context is convertible only through designated onshore banks, and each capital movement must be justified by an FDI registration, foreign debt filing, or special licence. Profit remittance from a WFOE requires verified audited financial statements, corporate income tax settlement certificate, bank FX reporting, and evidence of no outstanding regulatory liability. Taiwan treats TWD as generally externally convertible, but a Taiwan shareholder transferring funds into mainland China must use legitimate cross-strait banking channels and satisfy Taiwan CBC and Ministry of Finance AML/CFT screening; no automatic onshore convertibility exists for speculative positions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: The WFOE's licensed micro-lending operations do not generate goods export proceeds; therefore, the goods-export surrender regime is not a primary treasury input. For any ancillary cross-border service receipts, SAFE's trade-in-services supervision requires repatriation to a domestic FX account by the bank verification deadline (normally based on the contract payment schedule, with the annual trade credit category determining the relaxation or acceleration of the timeline). There is no statutory mandatory conversion ratio under the current goods-trade foreign exchange administration framework. The enterprise may elect to retain up to 100% of qualified current-account receipts in a FX account or sell it to a designated bank in the onshore RMB market; however, the bank must verify the goods-trade declaration and receipt book, and any pre-received payment exceeding 30 days must be reported in SAFE's monitoring system.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low as the primary treasury rail, Medium only as a technical payment aggregator for non-client operational expenses. Offshore digital EMIs are not permitted to open virtual account ledgers for a mainland WFOE's client funds, do not hold PBOC settlement licences, and cannot clear RMB loan originations or repayments. They may be used for limited cross-border opex payables and supplier payments, but all lending principal and repayment flows must be settled through PBOC-licensed onshore third-party payment institutions and SAFE-regulated bank accounts.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory. The legal representative, at least one director, and the authorised signatory must appear in person at a mainland PBOC-supervised bank branch for face-to-face KYC and transaction-purpose interview. Remote online opening is generally not available for a non-resident-controlled WFOE in a high-risk financial-service segment; even where pilot video onboarding exists, branch managers require an initial in-person meeting and verified corporate chop/seal. The Taiwan shareholder's corporate documents must be apostilled/legalised and accompanied by the board resolution that expressly authorises capital injection and account signatories.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk classification: unlicensed consumer lending, P2P platform exposure, or suspected money-services business without a financial regulator licence.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Specialised internet micro-lending or small-loan company licence issued by the competent provincial financial regulatory bureau; evidence of registration in PBOC's financial institution/plantform recordation; audited financial statements; AML/CFT compliance manual; suspicious transaction reporting (STR) procedures; borrower underwriting and collections policy; proof that lending rates are capped by the LPR×4 usury ceiling; no public-deposit-taking language in any platform contract.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity or unresolved source of funds on the Taiwan parent side.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) register up to 25%; shareholding chart; certificate of incorporation and articles; board resolution for capital contribution; audited Taiwan parent financial statements; bank reference letter from the Taiwanese remitting bank; source-of-wealth evidence for the Taiwan investor; valid passport/official ID and tax residence certificates of all directors and UBOs.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border capital inflow flagged as unreported investment, disguised dividend distribution, or round-tripping through an offshore intermediary.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SAFE FDI registration and e-recordation; bank confirmation of Capital Escrow Account opening; cross-border RMB payment system (RCPMIS) reporting instructions; capital contribution calendar; underlying investment contract; confirmation that the Taiwan shareholder is not a shell company; no pending administrative sanctions from PBOC or SAFE.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Suspected loan-flow layering or use of digital wallets to obscure the true borrower and lender identities.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: PBOC-licensed payment institution custody agreement; daily loan-file reconciliation; algorithm-underwriting system audit trail; list of borrower accounts; repayment waterfall records; KYC files for every funded borrower; system controls that enforce Bangladesh as no, actually enforce one-to-one identity binding; anti-fraud and sanctions-screening snapshots; appointment of a designated AML compliance officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Terrorist financing concern arising from cross-border payment to sanctioned jurisdictions or unverified technology vendors.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SANCTION LIST screening result (UN, OFAC, EU, China’s own list and Taiwan’s FIU list); geographic IP/proxy filtering evidence; vendor due-diligence file; export-controlled software licences; detailed cloud-hosting agreements; payment invoice and SWIFT details; board-approved procurement policy.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The lawful route begins with a Taiwan-side board resolution which is notarised, then the mainland WFOE completes FDI basic information registration through the local market supervision authority and SAFE e-recordation. The bank designated for the Capital Escrow Account must receive an SWIFT MT103 from the Taiwan shareholder remitting bank; the remittance field must state the purpose as 'FDI capital subscription / cross-border RMB investment capital' and provide a matching FDI registration certificate or SAFE system record number. The receiving bank validates the source of funds, records the payment in RCPMIS (for RMB) or the SAFE capital project information system (for FX), and credits the funds only to the dedicated Capital Escrow Account. Funds in the capital account may then be settled into RMB for operational purposes under the bank's supervision against submitted invoices, contracts, salaries, rents and loan-origination operating costs.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Operational cross-border vendor payments should use SWIFT MT103 with the standard SAFE current-account purpose code for service fees or royalties, supported by an invoice, contract, tax withholding certificate and bank payment application. Commercial letters of credit (LC) are not a relevant clearing rail for a micro-lending treasury: no commodity export/import flows are anticipated. Loan disbursements and repayments must be executed through China National Advanced Payment System (CNAPS) ACH direct debits to borrower deposit accounts and licensed local wallet payout systems (e.g., Alipay/WeChat Pay channels used through PBOC-regulated payment institutions). Under no circumstances may loan principal be routed out of the WFOE to an offshore wallet or to a Taiwan account in a manner that turns the internal lending platform into a cross-border money remitter.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore RMB/USD forward contracts with trade or foreign-debt backing, transacted through a SAFE-approved designated FX bank after underlying verification.
Cross-currency swaps (CCS) used solely to hedge the WFOE's registered foreign-debt or shareholder loan interest/principal exposures, not for speculative open positions.

Offshore non-deliverable forwards executed by the Taiwan parent (outside SAFE onshore supervision) to hedge anticipated cross-strait cash remittances, provided that such instruments do not create onshore RMB settlement obligations and comply with Taiwan CBC derivatives conduct rules.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: AGM-Approved Financial Statements and Annual Return Recordal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) – Company Registration Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: AGM on or before 30 June after fiscal year-end; financial statements filed within 15 days after AGM (latest by 15 July)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Directors liable to NT$10,000–NT$50,000 fine; repeated non-compliance may trigger MOEA order for dissolution or deregistration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Annual Return (including Unappropriated Earnings Surtax)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local National Taxation Bureau (Ministry of Finance)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 May – 31 May of the following calendar year (fiscal year ending 31 December)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge: 1% of unpaid tax per 2 days, capped at 15%; interest at 15% p.a. on underpayment; false-return penalty up to 3× understated tax; possible criminal liability.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual AML/CFT Compliance and Risk Assessment Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) / Taiwan Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months after fiscal year-end (31 March for calendar year)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to NT$5 million under Money Laundering Control Act; suspension or revocation of special lending platform license for severe non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign Investment Annual Performance Report (Business Operation Survey)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 May, or within 5 months after fiscal year-end (whichever is applicable)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine under Foreign Investment Act; for repeated failure, suspension or revocation of foreign investment approval and overseas remittance privileges.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent CPA audit for licensed financial institutions (including fintech lending platforms), public/listed companies, companies with paid-in capital ≥ NT$30 million, or those exceeding revenue thresholds set by the Business Entity Accounting Act.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Taiwan Financial Reporting Standards (TIFRS) – equivalent to IFRS – required for FSC-regulated financial entities; non-public companies may apply Enterprise Accounting Standards (EAS) or ROC GAAP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annual re-verification of beneficial ownership for all direct and indirect owners holding ≥10% interest, mandatory for high-risk financial license holders; enhanced due diligence re-conducted each 12 months; any share transfers must update UBO register within 7 days; nominee or undisclosed majority ownership prohibited.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Supervisors / Non-Executive Directors (if applicable)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard PRC Enterprise Income Tax rate is 25%. Qualifying small-scale low-profit enterprises may apply the reduced 20% rate with preferential effective loadings on taxable income thresholds; High and New Technology Enterprises may apply 15%; eligible integrated-circuit and software enterprises may access exemption/reduction periods; qualified R&D expenditures are eligible for additional deductions. A licensed micro-lending WFOE must still satisfy all industry, licensing and substantive conditions; no automatic sectoral tax holiday applies solely for P2P micro-lending.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: PRC Enterprise Income Tax annual return: Form A100000 (《中华人民共和国企业所得税年度纳税申报表（A类，2017年版)》) and supporting schedules; e-filed through the State Taxation Administration e-Taxation portal (电子税务局) after quarterly provisional filings.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly provisional CIT return within 15 days after each quarter-end; annual reconciliation return within 5 months after fiscal year-end. For a calendar-year WFOE, the annual return is due by May 31.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 营业收入: total revenue including microloan interest, platform service fees, commissions and other operating income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Chinese-resident WFOE completes this form. A non-resident Taiwan shareholder does not file this form; non-resident income is subject to PRC withholding-at-source procedures.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 利润总额: accounting total profit before tax adjustments, including gross interest spread, fee income and operating expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Not applicable to non-resident shareholder; this line is part of the resident WFOE's annual reconciliation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 纳税调整增加额: book-to-tax increases, including non-deductible financial provisions, excessive related-party service charges, non-commercial entertainment expenses and disallowed loan-loss provisions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Tax adjustments must be reviewed against cross-border related-party charges from Taiwan group entities; non-resident suppliers do not file this schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 免税、减计收入及加计扣除: tax-exempt income, deemed reductions and additional deductions, such as qualified R&D super-deduction.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Treaty or Cross-Strait arrangement rates on outbound payments are applied at withholding, not in this resident-entity line.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 实际应纳所得税额: actual CIT payable after loss carryforwards, concession rates and foreign tax credit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE's tax liability is separate from the Taiwan shareholder's withholding tax liability on distributed dividends.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 企业所得税弥补亏损明细表: loss-carryforward schedule tracking prior-year tax losses against current taxable income within the 5-year statutory period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only the resident WFOE's own audited tax losses may be carried forward; Taiwan-parent losses cannot be set off against PRC taxable income.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: warning or fine up to RMB 2,000, or RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000 in serious cases under Tax Collection Law Article 62. Late payment: daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05% on unpaid tax. Evasion or false declaration: penalty of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax plus surcharge, with criminal referral for serious tax evasion.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% deemed withholding rate for dividends paid by a PRC resident enterprise to foreign non-resident corporate shareholders without a permanent establishment in China; under the Cross-Strait Double Taxation Arrangement, the rate may be reduced to 5% where the Taiwan resident beneficial-owner enterprise directly holds at least 25% of the WFOE's paid-up capital, otherwise 10%.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Before remitting dividends, the PRC withholding agent must submit the non-resident treaty/arrangement benefits application through the STA e-Taxation module, attach the Taiwan tax resident certificate (TRC), beneficial-ownership declaration, shareholding record evidencing the 25% threshold, and supporting substance documentation. Processing follows STA Announcement No. 60 (2015) record-filing and assessment procedures; reduced rates cannot be applied without a valid TRC and adequate beneficial-ownership evidence.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory non-resident withholding tax on cross-border interest and royalty payments sourced in China is 10% each. Under the Cross-Strait Double Taxation Arrangement, a qualifying Taiwan resident beneficial owner may reduce withholding on both interest and royalties to 7%, subject to TRC submission, beneficial-ownership review, and absence of conduit arrangements.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Master File is required where aggregate annual related-party transactions exceed RMB 1,000,000,000. Local File thresholds are: tangible asset transfers above RMB 200,000,000; intangible asset transfers above RMB 100,000,000; financial asset transfers above RMB 100,000,000; and other related-party transactions above RMB 40,000,000 in a single year.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The PRC does not apply offshore-style Economic Substance Regulations (ESR). Substance is nonetheless enforced through place-of-effective-management rules, beneficial-ownership doctrines, controlled-foreign-company rules, the General Anti-Avoidance Rule (GAAR), and special tax adjustment powers. A licensed micro-lending WFOE must maintain actual headcount, physical office, underwriting and credit decision-making, risk-management systems, regulatory licence and books in China; artificial Taiwan-based conduit arrangements may be disregarded or recharacterised.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Falsifying books, understating loan interest or platform fee revenue, inflating costs, using fake service providers, or repeatedly refusing to file CIT returns.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax Collection Law Article 63 imposes penalty of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax plus 0.05% daily late-payment interest; Criminal Law Article 201 provides for imprisonment, criminal fines and asset confiscation for serious tax evasion.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Legal representatives may face exit bans (出境限制) for unpaid tax liabilities; courts may pierce the WFOE's corporate veil under PRC Company Law where assets are stripped, making directors and controlling shareholders jointly and severally liable; responsible officers may be criminally prosecuted.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a P2P or micro-lending platform, soliciting public deposits, or conducting internet lending without the required financial regulator licence and payment-rail authorisations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: PRC Criminal Law Articles 176 and 225 impose penalties for illegal public deposit-taking and illegal business operation, including imprisonment, fines and confiscation; the platform is subject to administrative closure, revocation and disgorgement of illegal gains.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, beneficial owners and officers who approved or controlled the unlicensed lending scheme face personal criminal liability, travel restrictions, asset freezing and disqualification from corporate office; cross-border fund movement can trigger mutual legal assistance and confiscation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to implement customer due diligence, beneficial-ownership verification, large-transaction reporting, cross-border wire reporting or ongoing monitoring for micro-borrowers and lenders moving funds through ACH and local-wallet rails.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: PRC Anti-Money Laundering Law imposes rectification orders, fines, licence revocation and confiscation of illegal gains; criminal liability under Criminal Law Article 191 applies for knowing receipt or transfer of proceeds of crime.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Legal representatives, senior managers and AML compliance officers may be personally fined, disqualified from management positions and subjected to exit bans; intentional facilitation can result in imprisonment and personal asset forfeiture.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to prepare contemporaneous transfer-pricing documentation, making false related-party declarations, or charging Taiwan group entities non-arm's-length fees, interest-free shareholder loans, IP royalties or excessive management charges.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: PRC tax authorities may adjust taxable income, impose special-tax-adjustment interest at the basis rate plus 5 percentage points, and apply penalties of 50% to 500% for false declaration or underpayment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly set non-arm's-length pricing or strip profits into Taiwan group companies are exposed to joint liability where corporate form is abused; exit restrictions and collection actions may be pursued against the legal representative.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Remitting dividends, interest or royalties to Taiwan investors without withholding CIT, or applying the reduced 5%/7% Cross-Strait Arrangement rates without a valid Taiwan tax resident certificate and beneficial-ownership evidence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax Collection Law Article 69 imposes a penalty of 50% to 300% of the amount that should have been withheld; the tax authority may also collect the under-withheld tax from the withholding agent or the non-resident recipient.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The legal representative and financial officers responsible for withholding may be personally ordered to make good the unpaid tax if corporate assets are insufficient, and may face travel bans and administrative or criminal fines.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Inserting a Taiwan or third-jurisdiction shell company with no employees, offices, risk functions or commercial purpose solely to obtain reduced withholding rates or defer PRC tax on microlending profits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Beneficial-ownership denial, reversion to the 10% statutory withholding rate, GAAR recharacterisation, back-dated interest, penalties of 50% to 500% and possible criminal referral for fraud.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts may pierce the corporate veil and hold directing shareholders personally liable for the unpaid tax and penalties; persons concerned may be subject to travel bans, asset freezes and disqualification from serving as directors.
